coach_note: Sun Nov 22 - Portofino. Cardio is the main event: no cardio Saturday, so today restarts the week's Zone 2 goal (45 min at 120-129). Recovery is good - readiness 80, HRV 48 (above the 42 average), 7.6 h sleep, resting HR 46 - so a solid 50 minutes is fine, but keep it steady: Friday's run already spent the week's Zone 4-5 budget. Then a short strength block as the first AMRAP session: one set per exercise taken to the first rep that loses form, logged as the real number. Decline push-ups are the one to watch - your hardest variant and the one that progresses. Legs were Friday and back was Saturday, so no leg press and no pulldown today.

exercises.note: Main set. 5 min easy, then hold 120-129 bpm for 30 min, 5 min easy. Covers most of the week's Zone 2 goal in one go.
Brisk walk at 3.5-3.8 mph, incline 2-3%, aiming 115-125 bpm. Walk only - keep it under 130 and save the running for Tuesday or Wednesday.
One warm-up, then one top set at 90 taken past 15 if you can - the first machine 'don't stop on the number' set. Yesterday was 70 and 90 x15.

Set 1 decline (feet up) AMRAP - your hardest variant; last two sessions were 15 and 20. Full 2-min rest, then regular AMRAP (yesterday 30; expect 35+). Skip incline today - the cardio is the volume. Progression: when decline passes 25, raise the feet or lower for 3 seconds.

One AMRAP set, slow: 2 seconds up, 3 seconds down, heels never touch the floor between reps. Stop when the lower back starts to arch. Every set for two months has been 20, so this tells us what 20 was hiding.
One AMRAP set per side, slow tempo, 1-second hold at the top.
Single-leg only, one AMRAP set per side with a 2-second squeeze at the top. Yesterday's 5 x 15 becomes 2 sets. Skip the two-leg version - it's too easy to be useful now.
